name: Contour
desc: The frame is surveyed rather than photographed — its luminance becomes a terrain and the pass inks the level lines across it, each contour cut as an engraved relief with a dark trough and a lit lip, the whole survey breathing because the field carries its own slow living warp.

energy.doc: line contrast: trough darkness, lit-lip brightness and glow amplitude

density.doc: number of contour levels (6 sparse -> 24 dense)

alpha.doc: overall ink opacity over the scene

warp.doc: how much the living field warps the frame's own levels (0 = read the frame almost straight, 1 = pure invented terrain)

style.doc: aesthetic: engraved relief line with a lit lip / broken directional hatching on a rotating rake / additive glowing wire contours with a halo (abstract) / clinical pale isolines on a knocked-back veil

act.doc: multi-minute program: breathe drifts gently / tide runs the levels steadily uphill so contours flow / pulse thickens the line on the beat / survey sweeps a reveal band down the frame
